# ElementBase

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Base class for PDF elements that provides common functionality for margin handling, Y-position tracking, and content width calculation. This reduces code duplication across elements and ensures consistent behavior.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Implements `IElement`, `IMargin`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ElementBase()
```

## Properties

- [`breakAllowed`](#breakallowed): Whether this element can be split across page boundaries.
- [`captureName`](#capturename): Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot.
- [`contentDirection`](#contentdirection): Inline direction override.
- [`keepWithNext`](#keepwithnext): Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.
- [`margin`](#margin): Margin around this element.

### `breakAllowed`

```typescript
breakAllowed: boolean
```

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.

### `captureName`

```typescript
captureName: string | undefined
```

Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot. Unset by default; a future capture API can populate it.

### `contentDirection`

```typescript
contentDirection: ContentDirection | undefined
```

Inline direction override. Undefined inherits the enclosing direction.

### `keepWithNext`

```typescript
keepWithNext: boolean
```

Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

### `margin`

```typescript
margin: Thickness
```

Margin around this element.

Reads as the canonical [`Thickness`](thickness.md); accepts any of the forgiving spacing forms on write (`12`, `[h, v]`, `[l, t, r, b]`, `{ bottom: 12 }`). Omitted sides are zero.

## Methods

- [`captureType`](#capturetype): Canonical element type name used for the layout snapshot tree.
- [`getPreferredWidth`](#getpreferredwidth): Gets the preferred width of this element, if any.
- [`measureHeight`](#measureheight): Measures the height of this element given the available width.
- [`render`](#render): Renders this element to the PDF context.

### `captureType`

```typescript
captureType(): string
```

Canonical element type name used for the layout snapshot tree. Defaults to the runtime class name; subclasses may override for a stable spec name.

### `getPreferredWidth`

```typescript
getPreferredWidth(): number
```

Gets the preferred width of this element, if any. This implementation includes margins.

### `measureHeight`

```typescript
measureHeight(availableWidth: number): number
```

Measures the height of this element given the available width. This implementation accounts for margins in addition to content height.

- `availableWidth`: - The available width for this element

### `render`

```typescript
render(ctx: RenderContext, width: number): void
```

Renders this element to the PDF context. This implementation handles margin application and Y-position tracking.

- `ctx`: - The render context
- `width`: - The available width for this element
